svg.title: b2-zombie-fact
svg.desc: b2-zombie-fact: 8 steps over 2 days from 2026-01-05 (decision open: pins current behaviour). Actors: a1 (agent, claude-code), h (human). an agent re-records a statement a human had forgotten with a reason. 1. [0d] a1 ingest # Pager policy → $pager; expects 4 things. 2. a1 remember The pager escalates to the CEO after five minutes. → $f1; expects 2 things. 3. [1d] h forget $f1; expects 1 thing. 4. h read $f1; expects 2 things. 5. a1 search pager escalates to the CEO; expects 2 things. 6. [2d] a1 remember The pager escalates to the CEO after five minutes. → $f2; expects 3 things. 7. a1 search pager escalates to the CEO; expects 3 things. 8. h facts ops; expects 2 things.
